facts.fact: The Hivos-led Eu SEE snapshot says journalist Sandra Muhoza received a four-year prison sentence on 14 January 2026 after arrest for 'undermining national territorial integrity' and 'inciting racial hatred' over information shared in a private press group, and was paroled on 4 March 2026.
The Eu SEE snapshot says Burundi's 2022 Cybercrime Act criminalises dissemination of 'false' or 'harmful' information.

BDI.note: Says only that data protection mechanisms are weak; no law, authority or application stated.
The 11.1% figure is DataReportal's, which the study notes and never uses.
